mapper.select: SELECT c.post_id AS postId, c.like_count AS likeCount FROM post_like_count c WHERE c.post_id IN #{postId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO post_like_count (post_id, like_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{postId}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count + #{delta}), update_time = NOW()
UPDATE post_like_count SET like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count - #{delta}), update_time = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
